runs.t: Where form meets function. Lightweight, sculptural panels ideal for high-rise buildings in high seismic zones — and for creating intricate shapes that traditional precast cannot achieve.
GFRC panels are an excellent choice for high-rise buildings in areas of greater seismic activity and for creating decorative and intricate shapes and applications.

GFRC panels are comprised of a 1" thick composite glass fiber concrete skin with flexible steel pins to the Infinite Facade frame — delivering unlimited diversity in color and form at a fraction of the weight of traditional precast.
